schools.notes: C9 sourced from C11 'All enrolled students' GPA distribution. Mapped 4.0 to 3.75-4.00. Lower-than-3.00 categories combined: 0.81% + 0.05% + 0.00% + 0.01% = 0.87%? Wait, C11 all-enrolled lower bands sum to 0.81 + 0.05 + 0.00 + 0.01 = 0.87; however the extracted table shows 0.81, 0.05, 0.00, 0.01; combined under 3.00 = 0.0087. ED/EA counts not provided in the PDF text.

C9 corresponds to CDS C11 in the provided text. Percentages were mapped as: 4.00=0.36 and 3.75-3.99=0.23 combined into 3.75-4.00=0.59; 3.50-3.74=0.16; 3.25-3.49=0.11; 3.00-3.24=0.07; below 3.00=0.07 from 2.50-2.99=0.06, 2.00-2.49=0.01, 1.00-1.99=0, below 1.00=0. C21 states no early decision and no early action plans, so counts are null.
C11 GPA table present but all GPA percentage cells are blank/0.00% and no usable distribution is reported. C21 Early Decision is reported; no Early Action applicant/admit counts are provided in C22.

C11 GPA table used for C9 because the provided text does not include a separate C9 high-school GPA distribution table; mapped 4.0 GPA to 3.75-4.00 and combined all sub-3.00 bands into <3.00. C21 indicates no early decision plan and an early action plan, but the PDF text provides no counts for EA applicants/admits or ED counts.

C9 extracted from C11 GPA table for all enrolled students; mapped 3.75-3.99 to 3.75-4.00 and combined all below 3.00 (2.50-2.99, 2.0-2.49, 1.0-1.99, below 1.0) into <3.00. C21 shows Early Decision and Early Action sections with no affirmative offerings and no counts reported.
